title: Monster
desc: Anjanam, who respects all life forms, faces trouble after a rat creates havoc in his house. While he tries to get rid of the rodent, a criminal breaks into his home to find his missing diamonds.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.

title: Pechi
desc: Accompanied by a guide, five friends go on a trekking trip to a haunted forest and despite being warned, they enter a restricted area that harbours an evil spirit.

title: K.G.F: Chapter 1
desc: Rocky, a young man, seeks power and wealth in order to fulfil a promise to his dying mother. His quest takes him to Mumbai, where he gets involved with the notorious gold mafia.

title: Rakshan the Ghost
desc: A former Interpol officer with a troubled past unleashes his skills in an attempt to protect his beloved family from kidnappers, rivals and death.
